headline: Weathered Expanse Again Leads Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the previous edition, WeatheredExpanseHex has intensified rather than slackened: eleven ownership events now fall within six hours, including five in the latest two, while casualty and enlistment rates accelerate on both sides. MooringCountyHex remains the other principal front, with twenty-five events in the past day—though its latest six hours are quiet—amid sharply rising casualties and enlistments; eleven Warden bases and one Colonial base are held. StlicanShelfHex has eased to eleven daily events, with four Warden and five Colonial bases currently standing, but both casualty streams and enlistments are climbing. CallahansPassageHex continues its sudden action, recording two fresh events at Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage in the latest two hours, with heavy, accelerating losses on both sides. PalantineBermHex retains eleven daily events and a six-to-one Warden majority, while its latest activity is older but recent fighting remains substantial. MarbanHollow has no recorded ownership event, yet its casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating sharply. Most other sectors report no recent base movement.
